title: Unit Conversion II
summary: Each conversion [a,b,f] states that one unit of a equals f units of b. Given the n-1 conversion relations, answer queries [a,b] with the amount of b equal to one a. Express a reduced ratio p/q as p times the modular inverse of q modulo 1000000007. Verify the connectivity and consistency guarantees.
